# Web Performance Optimization Full Guide

Use this guide for measurable performance improvements in frontend delivery.

## Scope

- Core Web Vitals triage
- Asset and bundle optimization
- Rendering and interaction performance
- Monitoring and regression guardrails

## Core Playbook

1. Measure baseline metrics.
2. Apply highest-impact optimizations first.
3. Validate UX and correctness post-change.
4. Track trends and enforce budgets.
